Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2><strong>What's the opportunity?</strong></h2> <p>Customer Agent is the next major evolution of Fin.</p> <p>We’re building toward a single AI agent that works across the full customer lifecycle, from support to sales to ecommerce, and eventually success.</p> <p>This role sits within a newer and fast-growing part of the organisation. The group is focused on expanding Fin beyond customer service into broader customer-facing jobs, building the product capabilities that allow one agent to work across multiple roles with shared context.</p> <p>The competitive landscape is intense. Fast-moving AI-native startups are shipping aggressively and going after the same deals we are. We need someone who thrives under that pressure and can maintain high standards while moving at startup speed.</p> <h2><strong>What will you do?</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You’ll own strategically significant work streams end-to-end.</li> <li>Be accountable for outcomes, not just delivery cadence or team health, but whether the work actually moved the needle.</li> <li>Manage from the front line: deeply understanding the product, the customer problem, and the context.</li> <li>Help shape teams operating in ambiguous spaces, especially where product direction is still emerging and close partnership with Product is essential.</li> <li>Work closely with cross-functional partners, including Product, Design, Sales, and machine learning engineers and scientists where relevant.</li> <li>Help build a seamless customer experience across sales, ecommerce, support and success, so customers interact with one agent experience rather than being passed between siloed systems.</li> <li>Sometimes that means writing code yourself. Sometimes it means doing the analysis, driving cross-functional collaboration, or force-multiplying someone on your team who’s stuck.</li> <li>You’ll bring together engineers who’ve never worked as a team, set high expectations, build momentum under aggressive timelines, and drive execution.</li> <li>Develop senior engineers into leaders. We need someone who accelerates staff and senior engineers, gives direct, actionable feedback that changes outcomes, and grows the leadership capacity of the people around them.</li> <li>Partner with the Engineering Director on group-level strategy: where to invest more, where we’re falling behind, and what we should stop doing to go harder somewhere else.</li&g

title: Operations Specialist, AI Enablement
description: Introduction to Role & Team Bumble Inc. is looking for an Operations Specialist, AI Enablement to join our CX & Trust team. Trust, care, and high-quality experiences are central to Bumble’s mission to create a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable, and in this role you’ll help bring that mission to life by improving how our AI-powered customer experience and moderation systems support our community. You’ll evaluate AI-powered customer interactions and automated moderation decisions against Bumble’s policies, processes, and quality standards, helping us understand where our systems are performing well and where they can improve. Through quality reviews, accurate case labelling, golden-set maintenance, and thoughtful analysis, you’ll help ensure AI-supported decisions are consistent, precise, and grounded in the nuance required to serve our members responsibly. You’ll work closely with the AI Performance & Enablement Manager and colleagues across CX & Trust, taking ownership of high-quality work and demonstrating our Bumble values of Courage, Curiosity, Respect, and Excellence as we reimagine how AI can strengthen trust and care across the member experience. This role will be based in London and will work in a hybrid model. What you’ll do Conduct quality reviews of AI-powered customer conversations and automated moderation decisions, assessing their alignment with Bumble’s community policies, operational processes, and quality standards. Analyse policy enforcement gaps and nuanced cases, identifying where automated decisions may be inconsistent, unclear, or misaligned with policy intent and surfacing actionable insights for improvement. Perform accurate case labelling to support AI model training, evaluation pipelines, and ongoing quality benchmarking, demonstrating Excellence through careful and consistent application of established guidance. Review and maintain golden sets that reflect current policy standards and provide reliable ground truth for assessing AI quality, accuracy, and precision. Report quality issues through established workflows, taking ownership of accurate categorisation, clear documentation, and actionable feedback, and seeing insights through to meaningful impact. Collaborate purposefully with the AI Performance & Enablement Manager on scoring consistency, calibration, recurring quality issues, and opportunities to strengthen AI reliability and the member experience. Identify patterns and share learnings that can improve AI accuracy and precision, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency, approaching emerging challenges with Curiosity and an agile mindset. Use QA platforms and AI-supported tools, including systems such as Cinder, Zendesk QA, and Bumble’s internal assessment tooling, to monitor quality and understand AI behaviour, reviewing outputs critically for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness and applying human judgment before acting on results. About you Requires 1+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills. Bring experience or transferable skills from Trust & Safety, content moderation, Customer Experience, quality assurance, or another fast-paced, policy-driven environment. Have a sharp eye for detail and can objectively evaluate conversations, moderation decisions, and other interactions against established policies, processes, and quality standards. Bring familiarity with conversational AI systems, chatbots, automated moderation, or AI-supported workflows, with the Curiosity to continue learning how these systems behave, where their limitations lie, and how human judgment can improve their effectiveness. Understand, or are motivated to learn, quality assurance practices such as case labelling, calibration, consistent scoring, golden-set evaluation, and clear documentation of quality findings. title: Sales Development Representative (UK)
description: Artemis is building the future of AI-driven defense – helping companies detect and defend themselves effectively in an era where AI is fighting AI on the cyber battlefield. We're backed by First Round Capital, Brightmind, and a group of the cybersecurity industry's most prominent Operators. Our founders, Shachar (ex-Palo Alto Networks, AWS, Demisto) and Dan (ex-Abnormal Security, Twitter) have previously built, launched, and scaled cybersecurity products loved and trusted by tens of thousands of customers, and have the customer, technology, and security know-hows to deliver this vision. Our exceptionally strong team includes software engineers, AI researchers, security engineers, and product designers hailing from Google, Abnormal AI, Wiz, Meta, AWS, and SentinelOne. We are growing our team and looking for passionate builders to join us and support our expanding customer base. The Role As an SDR at Artemis, you'll be the first point of contact for prospects. You'll research target accounts, run outbound campaigns, qualify inbound leads, and set meetings for our Account Executives. You'll work with a small but sharp sales team to build pipeline and help close enterprise security deals. This is a high-impact role—every meeting you set, every qualified lead, and every conversation directly feeds our growth. Responsibilities Run targeted outbound prospecting campaigns via email, LinkedIn, and phone to security leaders (CISOs, VPs of Security, Security Engineers) Research prospect companies, identify decision-makers, and understand their security posture and needs Qualify inbound leads and route to Account Executives with clear context Have discovery conversations to understand prospect pain points and determine fit Set meetings with qualified prospects, brief AEs on context before calls Build and maintain accurate pipeline in Salesforce Hit monthly activity targets (outreach, conversations, qualified meetings) Work closely with Account Executives to understand what makes a qualified lead and refine your targeting Provide feedback to the team on market trends, common objections, and competitive intel Qualifications 1-3 years in sales development, inside sales, or similar prospecting role (cybersecurity is a plus but not required) Comfortable making cold calls and sending cold emails without getting discouraged Research and research skills-you can dig into a company and find the right person to talk to Genuine curiosity about cybersecurity and how companies defend themselves (you'll learn fast) Strong communication skills Self-motivated and competitive-you own your pipeline and your numbers Comfortable with CRM (Salesforce) and sales tools (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.) Organized and detail-oriented Nice to Have Background in cybersecurity, security operations, or technical roles Experience prospecting to security buyers or IT decision-makers Familiarity with SIEM, EDR, or other security tools Experience at an early-stage SaaS or security company Right to Work & Visa Sponsorship You must have the right to work in the UK. title: Software Engineer
description: About Ping Identity:  At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.  Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.  While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture.  We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.  We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.  In this Software Engineer role, you will play an important part in the development of a market-leading, open standards first platform, providing flexible, modular and scalable identification, authentication, and authorization to a range of applications. Our mission is to understand the forces driving us apart, help societies find common ground and bring people together to tackle shared challenges. In the UK, our work is best described as being part consultancy and part think tank. We’ve helped national institutions such as the BBC, British Library and National Trust to better understand their audiences, we’ve helped partners in government and civil society with the set-up and delivery of the Homes for Ukraine scheme, and we’ve supported a range of partners to test their policy proposals from the National Farmers Union to Rethink Mental Illness among many others.
